customize.name: Zuppa di germogli di bambù sospetta
customize.desc: A soup dish that's been stewed for a good long while. The inexpert heat control has caused the fresh meat to be a bit tough, and the salty ham has covered the expected taste. The bamboo shoots, which have absorbed the flavors of both meats, are probably the only acceptable part of this dish.

customize.name: Zuppa di germogli di bambù
customize.desc: A soup dish that's been stewed for a good long while. The meat and ham have been diced into small pieces, and the soup has been kept on low heat till it turned milky white. The process has brought out the distinct flavors of both kinds of meat, making for an especially tasty soup.

customize.name: Zuppa di germogli di bambù deliziosa
customize.desc: A soup dish that's been stewed for a good long while. One whiff is enough to whet one's appetite greatly, and the concentrated flavors fill your body with every spoonful of soup. It is almost like spreading a pair of wings and walking on clouds.

customize.name: Zuppa di germogli di bambù cotti a fuoco lento
customize.desc: La specialità di Zhongli. Il prosciutto è stato selezionato secondo gli standard selezionati culinari del padiglione Yuehai. La carne fresca è pancetta di maiale, cacciato di recente nel Villaggio Acquachiara, mentre i germogli di bambù sono i più fritti che si possono trovare nel Villaggio di Qingce. Il tutto è stato cotto lentamente con molta cura e con grande tecnica: il suo gusto così "unico" può essere condiviso solo con coloro che sono in grado di apprezzarlo.

customize.desc: Un piatto ben presentato. Fa sicuramente la sua bella figura, ma dopo averlo assaggiato, si scopre quanto il consommé sia insipido. Che sia stato diluito troppo?

customize.name: Consommé ai tre sapori
customize.desc:
Un piatto ben presentato. I listelli tagliati uniformemente rivelano uno squisito lavoro di coltello. Sembra un'opera d'arte più che un piatto. Ma dopo che si trova il coraggio di prendere le bacchette e iniziare a mangiarlo, il sapore unico e inconfondibile induce un completo stato di beatitudine: sarebbe un vero peccato considerarlo una semplice opera

d'arte.

customize.name: Tonkotsu ramen sospetto
customize.desc: A steaming-hot noodle dish. The noodles were all but forgotten amid the hubbub of preparing the accoutrements, leading to it almost turning into a paste and becoming one with the soup. Oh well, at least you can drink the whole lot to salvage it a bit.

customize.name: Tonkotsu ramen
customize.desc: A steaming-hot noodle dish. The meat, prepared at low temperature, is laid over the noodles. Salty, fragrant, delicious soup seeps into each strand. A single bowl of these is guaranteed to restore any tired soul.

customize.name: Tonkotsu ramen delizioso
customize.desc: A steaming-hot noodle dish. The springy noodles have absorbed the essence of the soup, and the accoutrements have added all manner of variation to the mouthfeel. The soup has preserved the strong fragrance of the bones used to make it, yet goes down gently without that greasy feeling. Before you know it, the bowl's all gone, and you've still got room for more.

customize.name: Leggenda trionfante
customize.desc: Gorou's specialty. The side dishes have been piled high to form a sight as moving as Gorou's own motivations. As you finish the noodles and soup all in one go and pat your stomach in satisfaction, you look up and see Gorou... smiling radiantly as his tail wags from side to side (the latter probably unbeknownst to him!)

customize.name: Wakatakeni sospetto
customize.desc: A light-colored vegetarian dish. The seaweed takes forever to swallow and the overly-hard bamboo shoots look like they might wear out the teeth. Probably best left looked at but not eaten.

customize.name: Wakatakeni
customize.desc: A light-colored vegetarian dish. Broth is first poured into the pot before the bamboo shoots, and then the seaweed, are added in. The result is an elegant product with a light mouthfeel that agrees well with all palates. Suitable as a pre-meal appetizer or as a side to a main dish.

customize.name: Wakatakeni delizioso
customize.desc: A light-colored vegetarian dish. The new life born in the embrace of the ocean and the crisp freshness that sprouted in the mountains have blended into this broth. The light and gentle flavors give one a foretaste of the wonder of the four seasons, and of the revivification of all life.

customize.desc: A dish that is a test of one's knifework. The erratic knifework here has caused the ingredients to be sliced every which way. The tattered mouthfeel is enough to make one despair. Only the rank taste of beans stands as proof that the main ingredient of this dish was tofu in the first place.

customize.name: Tofu all'orchidea
customize.desc: A dish that is a test of one's knifework. All the ingredients were sliced into ribbons in a single go, and after being washed, they were placed into the broth and cooked till they floated. The resulting flavor is light and fresh, and would not be out of place as a chef's recommendation in a Liyue restaurant.

customize.name: Tofu all'orchidea delizioso
customize.desc: A dish that is a test of one's knifework. The tofu, thread-thin as the autumn leaves, floats amidst the bowl, like mist in a forest, and the shredded bamboo shoots give the image a sweet, lustrous sheen, while the broth combines the essence of fowl and ham, giving off an unbelievable aroma. A single taste is enough to cause the customer to lose themselves in this fog of flavor.
